articulo: S2 · Patagonia in January and February
caption:
January and February bring Patagonia's best hiking weather, and its biggest crowds.

If you are planning for early 2027, the refuges and campsites of the W Trek in Torres del Paine are the first thing to secure. Late is not the same as too late: there are still good ways to shape the trip.

The full guide is on our journal. Link in bio.

campos.title: Patagonia in January and February
campos.subtitle: What to book first, and what can wait

campos.title: Secure the W Trek first
campos.body: In summer, the refuges and campsites of the W Trek in Torres del Paine are the first thing to fill up. For January or February, we suggest starting to plan around June or July.
campos.alt: Trekking to the base of the Torres, Torres del Paine

campos.title: Late is not the same as too late
campos.body: With short notice, day tours and some glacier visits may still have space, and routes like the Carretera Austral are easier to improvise. We adapt the route instead of forcing it.
campos.alt: Marble Caves, General Carrera Lake, Carretera Austral

campos.title: Summer still needs layers
campos.body: January and February bring the most pleasant hiking weather, but Patagonian wind and weather can change fast. Pack layers and a waterproof, windproof outer shell.
